confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live menus, rates or listings. Restaurant prices are moderately reliable; accommodation (July is low season, taxes and fees assumed included) and drink prices are less certain. The 0.6947 FX rate came from a third-party page that attributes it to the RBA. I did not verify it on rba.gov.au, and an RBA page snippet referenced 15 October 2026, so the date may be off by one day.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single named comparable city. Estimated from the Caribbean resort-town tourism pricing pattern (USD-priced tourist services, Jamaican local-restaurant prices, and July low-season hotel rates). Drinks were set from typical resort-bar levels relative to beer.
